relationship_description: Sonia D. Paglicauan received an award from President Ferdinand Bongbong Marcos Jr. during the 125th founding anniversary of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) at the DPWH Head Office in Manila.
Sonia D. Paglicauan was awarded in a ceremony attended by DPWH Secretary Manuel M. Bonoan, who joined President Marcos in handing out the awards.
Sonia D. Paglicauan was awarded in a ceremony attended by Senior Undersecretary Emil K. Sadain, who joined President Marcos in handing out the awards.

DPWH Secretary Manuel M. Bonoan, a presidential appointee, was present at the awarding and is responsible for executive and managerial appointments within DPWH, including the designation of Sonia D. Paglicauan as Officer-In-Charge, Office of the District Engineer, Batangas 2nd District Engineering Office.
